t: Contains a selection of popular sized VDE pliers. Slip-guard prevents any spark from non-insulated head to the hand. Chrome-plated heads for durability. Longer cutting edges for thicker cables and gripping zones for flat and round materials. Jaws are distortion-tolerant and feature elastic precision tips and knurled gripping surfaces. Induction-hardened for medium and hard wire. Narrow head for use in confined spaces.
